data: Which source type shows the highest frequency in September in the plot with smaller y-axis?

The question asks which source type shows the highest frequency in September in the plot with the smaller y-axis. From the caption, we know that the bottom plot shows the distribution for the Company Reports, Investor Reports, and News, using a smaller y-axis. 

Looking at the bottom plot, we can see that the yellow line (News) has the highest frequency in September compared to the other two lines (Company Reports and Investor Reports). Therefore, the source type that shows the highest frequency in September in the plot with the smaller y-axis is News.
